quests.title: The Dried Springs of Elarion
quests.description: The sacred crystalline waters flowing into Whispering Village have suddenly ceased. Investigate the cause and restore water before the harvest fails.

pathways.title: Inspect the River Aqueduct & Clockwork Machinery
pathways.description: Head down to the roaring sluice gates where Mira's gears have seized up near ancient mechanical automata.

pathways.title: Commune with the Ancient Forest Spirit
pathways.description: Venture into the misty canopy of the Ancient Grove to petition Sylvan, guardian of the mountain springs.

pathways.title: Delve into the Subterranean Energy Vaults
pathways.description: Explore beneath the old reservoir where runic conduits require sustained repetitive energy pulses.
